title: 第9章 她或许真的变了
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
方子尧以为她是期待云师兄还给她带来哪些话，继续说道：“当然不是，云师兄还说了，若是你把玄天灵参送过去给他，让阮师姐恢复了修为，兴许还能看在你知错就改的份上，既往不咎。”

    路仙瑶真不知道云鹤珏哪里来的脸，跟她要东西都要得这么理直气壮。

    看来，是上回打得太轻了，下回得下重手一点！

    “那你回去告诉他，玄天灵参没有！”

    “没有？”方子尧瞪大了眼，“怎么会没有？你上次去我们天鸣剑宗的时候，还带着的！”

    说到上次，路仙瑶就来气！

    要不是她表兄及时赶到天鸣剑宗，她怕是就真死在阮惜惜的手里了！

    表兄又怎么可能让玄天灵参被云鹤珏拿走？自然是与她一道带回瑶池了。

    “我说没有就没有，你把这个带回去给云鹤珏，三天内让他把这些东西送过来，他若不送，我亲自上门要！”路仙瑶把手里的清单折子甩到方子尧脸上，不等他打开来看，就下逐客令。

    “送客！”

    随后，有两名守卫上前，把方子尧给架走。

    瑶池的守卫修为最低是结丹初期，而方子尧不过是筑基初期，被架着出去，也不敢动弹。

    只是这不应该啊？

    之前替云师兄给路仙瑶传过话的师兄们说，路仙瑶为了讨得云师兄欢心，即便是传话的，也不吝啬赠予法宝。

    怎么他什么都没有，还被赶走啊？

    那他从众位师兄弟中，拼命博得他们二人传话的媒介，有何意义？

    他对路仙瑶说道：“路仙瑶，你竟然赶我走？你可知道，我是云师兄让我过来的，你当真不怕云师兄日后再也不理你了吗？”

    “下次让他换个有震慑力点的威胁。”路仙瑶冷笑。

    这种不痛不痒的威胁，对她有什么用？

    站在距离广场不远处的山头上，注视着下方广场的镜辞，将路仙瑶的变化尽收眼底。

    他早就察觉到路仙瑶自受了阮惜惜一掌后，醒来整个人跟换了个人似的，性格也与从前截然不同。

    如今还将云鹤珏的人赶走，不知道她又在做什么。

    估计又是想以此引起云鹤珏的注意罢了，她从前也经常这样，故意晾着云鹤珏，待他过来寻她。

    可她等啊等，怎么也等不到云鹤珏来，最后只能带上法宝去天鸣剑宗寻他。

    那么多次了，她竟也没玩腻。

    镜辞摇摇头。
content_en:
Fang Ziyao thought that she was expecting something else from Senior Brother Yun, and continued: "Of course not. Senior Brother Yun also said that if you send Xuantian Spirit Ginseng to him and help Senior Sister Ruan recover her cultivation, maybe I can forgive you for letting the past go."

    Lu Xianyao really didn't know where Yun Hejue's face came from, and he had to be so confident when asking for something from her.

    It seems that I hit him too lightly last time, so I need to hit him harder next time!

    "Then you go back and tell him that there is no Xuantian Spirit Ginseng!"

    "No?" Fang Ziyao's eyes widened, "How come there isn't? You brought it with you when you went to our Tianming Sword Sect last time!"

    Speaking of last time, Lu Xianyao got angry!

    If her cousin hadn't arrived at the Tianming Sword Sect in time, she might have died in the hands of Ruan Xixi!

    How could my cousin let Xuantian Spirit Ginseng be taken away by Yun Hejue? Naturally, he took her back to Yaochi.

    "If I say no, I won't. You take this back to Yun Hejue and ask him to deliver these things within three days. If he doesn't deliver them, I will come to ask for them in person!" Lu Xianyao threw the list in Fang Ziyao's face, and before he could open it to look at it, he issued an eviction order.

    "Send off guests!"

    Then, two guards came forward and took Fang Ziyao away.

    The lowest cultivation level of Yaochi's guards was in the early stage of foundation building, and Fang Ziyao was only in the early stage of foundation building. He was carried out and did not dare to move.

    It’s just that this shouldn’t be the case?

    The senior brothers who had previously conveyed messages to Lu Xianyao on behalf of Senior Brother Yun said that in order to please Senior Brother Yun, Lu Xianyao did not hesitate to give away magic weapons even though he was the messenger.

    Why was he driven away when he had nothing?

    So what's the point of trying so hard to get a medium for the two of them to communicate from among the brothers?

    He said to Lu Xianyao: "Lu Xianyao, you actually drove me away? Do you know that I was sent here by Senior Brother Yun? Are you really not afraid that Senior Brother Yun will ignore you in the future?"

    "Let him use a more intimidating threat next time." Lu Xianyao sneered.

    What use would such a harmless threat have to her?

    Standing on the hilltop not far from the square, looking at the mirror in the square below, he could see all the changes in Lu Xianyao.

    He had long noticed that after Lu Xianyao received Ruan Xixi's palm, she seemed to be a different person when she woke up, and her personality was completely different from before.

    Now she has driven away Yun Hejue's people. I don't know what she is doing.

    She probably wanted to attract Yun Hejue's attention again. She had often done this in the past, deliberately leaving Yun Hejue alone until he came to look for her.

    But she waited and waited, but she couldn't wait for Yun Hejue to come. In the end, she had no choice but to take the magic weapon to the Tianming Sword Sect to look for him.

    Even after so many times, she never got tired of it.

    Jingci shook his head.
title_en: Chapter 9 She may have really changed
